mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_text_units WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash = #{fileHash}

SELECT material_id AS materialId, file_hash AS fileHash, COUNT(*) AS unitCount, MIN(unit_no) AS firstUnitNo, MAX(unit_no) AS lastUnitNo, MAX(unit_type) AS unitType FROM material_text_units WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY material_id, file_hash
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_text_units WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND file_hash = #{fileHash}
DELETE FROM material_text_units WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId}
